name: Burndown Time Tracker
description: Submodule of Burndown: per-user start/stop task timers and an hours report/editor for work-log entries.
project_description: Burndown Time Tracker is an optional submodule of Burndown that adds time reporting and editing tools for Burndown work-log entries on Tasks. It provides a per-user start/stop task timer (a floating widget backed by a small custom table), records elapsed time as a 'work' log entry on the task when stopped, an 'Hours' report view for the current user, an individual time-entry edit form, and a 'Manage work timers' screen for time managers. It adds one permission, 'manage user work hours', for managers to edit any user's hours and manage running timers. Depends on the parent burndown module and core views.
